In the Heart of Barramundi Country
Lee and Jenny’s BushCamp is a privately owned and operated business that started in 2012 as a bush campground/caravan park for family and friends who have the love for the bush and barramundi fishing here on the Daly River. Encouraged by these people Lee and Jenny’s Bushcamp evolved. Covering a broader range of accommodation to suit all budgets. Ranging from fully self-contained accommodation down to camping in the bush all with shade and grass. Having fished the Daly river since the late 80’s and then in the late 90’s we had our own guided fishing business we try to share this knowledge with our patrons and friends. We utilise this knowledge to help our clients tick their first Barramundi off the list or chase that allusive one-meter barramundi which is everybody’s dream.

pages.text:
About - Lee & Jenny's About Us
Lee and Jenny’s is set on the picturesque Daly River only 110 kilometres west of Adelaide River
offering modern facilities amongst a natural bush setting accessible by all sealed roads to one of the NT’s
best Barramundi fishing spots. A quite relaxed, friendly and comfortable atmosphere where you can
wake up with the sounds of nature awaits you.
Set on 320 acres with walking tracks to view the wildlife in their natural habitat. It is a bird watchers
paradise, with over 100 species sited and listed to date.
For those land-based fishermen Bamboo Creek is one of the NT’s iconic locations for catching big
Barramundi and is only a short walk from the camp just meters from your accommodation.
Lee and Jenny’s BushCamp also have on offer mobile and internet reception, a viewing point on the
river bank for croc spotting and socializing, jetty/pontoon to moor to taking the daily launching of
the boat out of the equation. A camp kitchen and BBQ’s are available to all park guests along with a shade covered
swimming pool. Pet-friendly. Drinking water available. Guided fishing tours and packages available
